query: Build a workflow that: 1) Receives a Kommo webhook when a lead status changes, 2) Extracts the phone from the lead, 3) Sends a WhatsApp message via Z-API saying 'Your lead has been updated'.
expected_behavior: Extracts phone from custom_fields in a Code node
Configures HTTP Request for Z-API send-text with =phone prefix
Responds to Kommo webhook within 2 seconds
Mentions both node types and credentials needed

baseline_without_skill.likely_response: May struggle with both Kommo webhook structure and Z-API HTTP configuration
baseline_without_skill.expected_quality: Low - would likely get both webhook data access and Z-API config wrong

with_skill_expected.response_quality: High - complete end-to-end workflow with correct nodes and expressions
